source: eCC Résumé Review applet, My rules tab

rules.title: 30-second ad
rules.text: The résumé is a 30-second ad for the candidate's professional toolkit. Write it like bumper stickers: short, punchy lines a reader can scan. Flag dense paragraphs and long bullets.

rules.title: WIM ("Wow is Me") section
rules.text: Executives open with a WIM area made of 3 short paragraphs: (1) quantified accomplishments (hard skills) and contributions; (2) the soft skills that make the candidate unique among the other applicants for this position; (3) who they are, ideally drawn from personality profiling assessments. Flag any missing paragraph. If paragraph 3 is missing or generic, recommend personality profiling.

rules.title: Quantified contributions
rules.text: Accomplishments should be quantified (revenue, cost, time, headcount, percentages, scale). Most clients need help seeing how their contributions can be quantified. Flag bullets that describe responsibilities instead of results.

rules.title: Company left, dates right
rules.text: Company names sit in the left gutter and the dates of each assignment sit on the right side.

rules.title: Oxford comma
rules.text: Use the Oxford comma in every list of three or more. It provides complete clarity. Flag each missing one.

rules.title: So What? Says Who?
rules.text: Read each line (aloud, ideally) and ask "So What?" then "Says Who?" Every claim needs a result that matters and evidence behind it, backed by a story the candidate can tell. Flag claims that fail either question.

rules.title: Submit as PDF
rules.text: Always submit the résumé as a PDF. It guarantees the résumé looks as intended: fonts, spacing, special characters.

rules.title: Clear section breaks
rules.text: Make the separation between sections incredibly easy to see by adding white space between them.

rules.title: Left-justified text
rules.text: Use left justification, not full (both-sides) justification. Left justification adds white space.

rules.title: Formatting comes last
rules.text: Formatting is the last thing to fix. Put content and quantification feedback ahead of formatting feedback.

rules.title: 5 / 4 / 3-4 bullets
rules.text: Use 5 bullet points in the most recent job, 4 in the previous position, and 3-4 RELEVANT points in earlier positions.

rules.title: Tailored from a base résumé
rules.text: Keep one base résumé with every accomplishment back to the start of the career, and turn those successes into SAR stories. Each application uses a copy with anything that doesn't apply to the target role removed. Flag content irrelevant to the target role.

rules.title: Exact target title at top
rules.text: Put the exact title of the position being pursued at the top of the résumé, changed for each application.
